item.title: Agreena Achieves SustainCERT Verification for Scope 3 Carbon Project
item.description: Agreena has achieved verification of its Scope 3 project from SustainCERT, marking the completion of its dual pathway verification model.

item.title: RenX Enterprises Deploys Automated Processing Equipment at Florida Facility
item.description: RenX Enterprises deployed a Komptech XL3 trommel screener with automated three-stacker conveyor system at its 80-acre Myakka City.

item.title: Swegreen Brings In-Store Growing System to ICA Kvantum Märsta
item.description: ICA Kvantum Märsta has selected Swegreen's in-store growing technology, with the Saga Medium system launching in spring 2026.

item.title: Forever Feed Technologies Secures $15M Contract for Commercial Hydroponic Feed Systems
item.description: Forever Feed Technologies gets a $15M contract with River Ranch Farms to build a hydroponic livestock feed growing center in Hanford, CA.

item.title: Ever.ag Launches Agentic AI Capabilities in Roger Agricultural Freight Platform
item.description: Ever.ag announced the launch of agentic AI capabilities within Roger, its agricultural freight execution platform.

item.title: Cox Vastgoed Acquires 5.2-Hectare Greenhouse Facility in Sevenum
item.description: Cox Vastgoed B.V. will acquire a 5.2-hectare greenhouse facility from paprika grower Frank Bakker in Sevenum on December 1, 2026.

item.title: Anaergia Secures California's First SB 1440 RNG Contract Approval
item.description: CPUC conditionally approved a long-term biomethane procurement contract between Anaergia's SoCal Biomethane, Anew Climate, and Southwest Gas.

item.title: Total Seed Production Acquires Bayer's Windfall Soybean Facility in Indiana
item.description: Total Seed Production acquired Bayer's soybean facility in Windfall, Indiana on March 16th, marking an expansion of its production footprint.

item.title: Agrim Raises $17.3M in Series B Funding Round Led by Asia Impact Fund
item.description: Agrim raised $17.3M in Series B funding led by Asia Impact Fund, with continued support from Kalaari Capital, among other investors.

item.title: The Staple Crop Shift: How Crop Genomics Is Turning to Wheat and Rice
item.description: Explore how investment in crop genomics is shifting to staple crops like wheat and rice, impacting global food security.
